text: {"table": {"name": "sets", "purpose": "Magic: The Gathering card sets/expansions (one row per set, promo line, or special product release), with release metadata, set codes, and links to external store IDs. Structure matches MTGJSON's Set data."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "set_id", "description": "Primary key; internal numeric identifier for the set row.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "numeric", "name": "base_set_size", "description": "Number of cards in the set's base printing (non-promo, non-extra) — the 'baseSetSize'. Distribution (max 1694, most sets small) and near-duplication with col_020 fit card counts; the joins to cards/foreign_data are likely spurious statistics artifacts, not real foreign keys.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_003": {"role": "category", "name": "block", "description": "Name of the block the set belongs to (e.g. 'Theros', 'Shadows over Innistrad'); null for sets outside a block. Repeated values like 'Core Set', 'Commander' suggest some entries are block-style groupings rather than strict blocks.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "free_text", "name": "booster", "description": "JSON/Python-dict description of booster pack contents: per-sheet slot counts (basic, common, uncommon, rare/rareMythic, land, dfc/sfc slots) keyed by product variant ('default', 'arena'). Null for sets not sold in boosters.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "code", "name": "code", "description": "Unique 3–5 character set code (e.g. 'TSP' Time Spiral, '10E' Tenth Edition, 'PGRN' Guilds of Ravnica promos). Referenced by cards and set_translations.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "boolean", "name": "is_foil_only", "description": "Boolean flag; true for sets printed only in foil (167 sets, consistent with promo/premium sets).", "status": "tentative"}, "col_007": {"role": "boolean", "name": "is_online_only", "description": "Boolean flag; true for the 16 sets available only digitally (MTGO/Arena).", "status": "tentative"}, "col_008": {"role": "boolean", "name": "is_paper_only", "description": "Boolean flag; plausibly 'paper only' (106 sets never on MTGO), though the count seems low — could also be another set flag.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_009": {"role": "boolean", "name": "is_partial_preview", "description": "Boolean flag; true for the 26 sets that were partial previews of a later set.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_010": {"role": "boolean", "name": "is_foreign_only", "description": "Boolean flag; true for exactly one set, consistent with a foreign-language-only release.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_011": {"role": "code", "name": "block_code", "description": "Code of the block the set belongs to ('DEFAULT' for standalone sets, 'DCI'/'PMEI' for promo programs).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_012": {"role": "identifier", "name": "mcm_id", "description": "External ID for the set at Cardmarket (MKM); null for ~64% of sets (promos/memorabilia not listed there). The one-to-one joins to cards/foreign_data are likely statistical artifacts.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_013": {"role": "identifier", "name": "cardsphere_set_id", "description": "External Cardsphere set ID; present only for 10 recent sets (IDs 2371–3680), consistent with a newer database covering only recent sets. Could alternatively be another modern store ID.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_014": {"role": "free_text", "name": "mcm_name", "description": "Set name as listed at Cardmarket; pairs with col_012 (same null rate and row coverage).", "status": "tentative"}, "col_015": {"role": "code", "name": "parent_set_code", "description": "Code of the parent set for derivative releases (promos, masterpieces, variants); null for ~71% of sets. Sample values ('V10', 'PR', 'DRB') fit promo-to-parent links.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_016": {"role": "free_text", "name": "name", "description": "Full human-readable set name (e.g. 'Ultimate Masters', 'Magic Player Rewards 2001'); unique per row.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_017": {"role": "code", "name": "mtgo_code", "description": "Alternate set code used on MTGO/another platform; null for ~72% of sets. Repeated codes (ZNR x6) fit variant sets sharing a parent's code, so it could also be a 'code_v3'/alternate-code field rather than strictly MTGO.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_018": {"role": "date", "name": "release_date", "description": "Release date of the set (range 1993-08-05 Alpha to 2021-03-19); many promos use a generic January 1 date.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_019": {"role": "identifier", "name": "tcgplayer_group_id", "description": "External TCGplayer group/set ID; null for ~53% of sets (those not sold on TCGplayer). Value 62 repeated 21 times fits a shared 'promos' group.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_020": {"role": "numeric", "name": "total_set_size", "description": "Total number of cards in the set including variants/promos; slightly more distinct values than col_002 (base size), same range. Joins to other tables are likely spurious.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_021": {"role": "category", "name": "type", "description": "Set type/category: promo, expansion, memorabilia, box, duel_deck, draft_innovation, archenemy, spellbook, premium_deck, core, etc.", "status": "resolved"}}}
